mechanism: Structure a first-person product testimonial as a proof ladder: introduce the unopened object and speaker together, expose contents, isolate one tactile or functional macro proof, let the speaker perform one genuine use action, then hold the product and changed reaction together. The product claim must be earned by visible use rather than spoken hype.

invariants.rule: Open with presenter and unopened product in the same frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: A product-only beauty shot lacks testimonial ownership.

invariants.rule: Reveal the complete contents before isolating details.
invariants.purpose: Gives macro proof a known context.
invariants.ablation_failure: Macro-first editing can hide what is actually being evaluated.

invariants.rule: Choose one product-specific tactile or functional proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Generic close-ups create polish without evidence.

invariants.rule: Perform one complete use action with the outcome still visible.
invariants.purpose: Converts product state into demonstrated experience.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut before the result turns use into implication.

invariants.rule: End with product and changed human reaction readable together.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reaction without the object can feel unrelated or staged.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
